newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-DAVY JONES HURT IN IRL CRASH, CONDITION IMPROVED.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-DAVY JONES HURT IN IRL CRASH, CONDITION IMPROVED.

text.p: The condition of driver Davy Jones was upgraded after he regained consciousness Thursday following a crash in pre-race practice for Saturday's 200-mile Indy Racing League event.
Jones, co-winner of the 1996 LeMans 24 Hours and runner-up at last year's Indy 500, got sideways in the third turn driving a new G-Force Oldsmobile and hit the wall, suffering head injuries.
Jones was originally listed in critical condition but doctors at Orlando Regional Medical Centre upgraded his condition to serious.
Team owner Rick Galles said Jones had not suffered any broken bones and that after regaining consciousness at the hospital, was able to squeeze his wife Mary Elizabeth's hand.
